summary: Feed s053_single to APM is degraded due to 5.4% packet loss (144/2645 TCP packets with gaps). All other visibility checks (duplicates, one-way, VLAN, encryption, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Upstream capture loss - SPAN port buffer overflow or packet broker egress oversubscription dropping packets before they reach the APM. 5.44% exceeds 1% threshold, indicating sustained buffer exhaustion, not random loss.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will see incomplete TCP streams, inaccurate transaction latency/apdex, missed flows and broken correlation - requires both directions and headers but is receiving gapped data.

recommended_fix.why: APM needs_full_payload=false per profile, so slicing to headers + first bytes preserves flow/latency metadata while sharply reducing bandwidth and broker/SPAN buffer pressure to eliminate drops. If SPAN is the source, also plan replace_span_with_tap for lossless capture.
